current.text: He is not among the projected Warriors starters. Previews list Curry, Podziemski, Lendeborg, Green and Porzingis or Horford.
Golden State's depth is very poor and the team struggles to field a 10-man rotation, so minutes should go up across the rotation.
Steve Kerr runs unpredictable rotations and often changes a set lineup a few games in, with lots of mixing among the wings.
Curry is the only Warrior who creates his own shot, so the offense depends on him.
The Warriors are reportedly treating this season as a gap year. They may care about lottery odds and rest veterans.
Experts expect Warriors players to fade as the season goes on.
The Warriors have 15 back-to-backs, tied for second most, but their schedule is good for fantasy playoffs ending March 28.

durable.text: He scores by slipping screens and cutting to the basket off Curry's gravity. He is not a shot creator.

note: Both Yahoo and ESPN value him at 0 USD (rank 266 on Yahoo, 196 on ESPN), so he falls well outside our 144-player draft and is a waiver player. His fantasy value is efficient FG% (58.3% on 5.7 attempts last season) and few turnovers (0.8) in about 15 minutes, with little in points, threes or assists, so he only matters if Golden State's thin depth pushes his minutes up. Early in the season, watch whether his minutes climb clearly above 16 and whether Kerr's lineup changes put him on the floor with Curry.
